component.name: BackgroundScene
component.script:
sub init() print "color=";m.top.backgroundColor;",uri=";FormatJSON(m.top.backgroundUri) m.top.setFocus(true)
end sub function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key="right" then m.top.backgroundColor="0x123456ff" if key="down" then m.top.backgroundColor="0x000000ff" if key="left" then m.top.backgroundUri="" print "color=";m.top.backgroundColor;",uri=";FormatJSON(m.top.backgroundUri) if key="left" then print "@@PROBE_END" return true end function
